title: Amgen Ranks #4 on Forbes’ Most Innovative Large Companies List
summary: Amgen has been ranked #4 on Forbes’ inaugural list of America’s Most Innovative Large Companies, recognizing the company among the nation’s leaders in innovation.
body_markdown: For investors, Amgen's recognition as one of America's Most Innovative Large Companies highlights the company's continued investment in scientific research, artificial intelligence in drug discovery, and advanced manufacturing. These capabilities support Amgen's efforts to advance its pipeline, develop and manufacture innovative medicines, and drive long-term growth.
